title: Pokemon TCG Jacinthe 075/088 Reverse Holo ME03 Perfect Order Trainer Supporter
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Pokemon TCG card featuring Jacinthe from the Me03: Perfect Order set. It is a Trainer-Supporter card with a Reverse Holo finish, making it an uncommon collectible. The card is part of the Pokémon franchise, manufactured by The Pokémon Company in the United States. With a Colorless attribute and standard card size, this English-language card is illustrated by Susumu Maeya and is not autographed or vintage. It is a sought-after piece for collectors and players of the Pokémon Trading Card Game.
